'''Debashish Goswami'''  is an Indian mathematician.  He obtained his PhD degree from [[Indian Statistical Institute]] under the supervision of [[Kalyan Bidhan Sinha]]. He was awarded the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]] in 2012, the highest science award in [[India]], in the mathematical sciences category.<ref>{{cite web|title=Bhatnagar Prize Awardees 2012|url=http://csirhrdg.res.in/ssb2012_awardees.pdf|publisher=CSIR, New Delhi|accessdate=1 July 2013}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
*INSA medal for Young Scientists (2004)<ref name=award>{{cite web|title=Awards and Honours|url=http://www.isical.ac.in/~statmath/html/award.html|publisher=Indian Statistical Institute, Kolkata|accessdate=1 July 2013|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110613063517/http://www.isical.ac.in/~statmath/html/award.html|archivedate=13 June 2011}}</ref> 
*B. M. Birla Science Prize in Mathematics for the year 2006<ref name=award/>
* Swarnajayanti Fellowship from the Dept. of Science and Technology of Govt. of India in 2009
